item.title: AOC tells troops to refuse 'illegal' orders ahead of Trump's looming Iran deadline
item.summary: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez urged U.S. service members to refuse illegal orders after Trump, on social media, threatened to wipe out Iran's civilization.

item.title: STEVE FORBES: Iran’s nuclear insanity leaves America and allies no room to blink
item.summary: Iran's nuclear ambitions, massive missile arsenal and state-sponsored terrorism demand urgent Western action before the regime crosses final thresholds.

item.title: A-10 Warthog given new maritime role targeting boats in Iran after efforts to retire aircraft
item.summary: The A-10 Warthog has a new maritime role in targeting boats in the war in Iran that could extend the life of the aircraft after the U.S. Air Force had been attempting to retire it.

item.title: Pope Leo calls out Trump’s Iran rhetoric before last-minute ceasefire emerges
item.summary: Pope Leo called President Trump's threat against Iran 'truly unacceptable,' urging world leaders to return to the negotiating table and reject war always.

item.title: America is too dependent on drugs from China. Worst-case scenario could be disastrous
item.summary: U.S. pharmaceutical dependency on China poses urgent national security risks as Beijing dominates drug production and active pharmaceutical ingredients.

item.title: Terror suspects indicted after allegedly throwing bombs at NYC protest outside mayor's mansion
item.summary: The pair of terror suspects accused of trying to bomb a protest outside New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's residence in an ISIS-inspired attack have been indicted.

item.title: AOC doubles down on call for Trump's ouster even after ceasefire announcement
item.summary: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez calls for Trump's removal from office, asserting that his Iran ceasefire "statement changes nothing."

item.title: Inside Antifa-linked group's plan to 'structurally change' the US as May Day unrest approaches
item.summary: Sunrise Movement training materials reveal plans for mass strikes, eco-socialism, and a multi-phase strategy to dismantle the current political system.

item.title: Trump’s Iran threat rattles GOP as some Republicans break ranks
item.summary: Some Republicans publicly broke with Trump over his threat that a "whole civilization will die tonight" if Iran does not reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: JONATHAN TURLEY: This blue state's latest attack on free speech is awful and sneaky, too
item.summary: Colorado arguably ranks as the most anti-free speech state, pushing unconstitutional measures that have led to major First Amendment court losses.
